answer: Human emotion episodes do not originate from one emotion center. They emerge from distributed brain-body systems that integrate conserved regulatory circuits, interoception, allostasis, sensory context, memory, learned prediction, neuromodulation, action selection, and report.
proposed_contribution: ORIGIN - Organismal Reconstruction of Integrated Generative Neuroaffect - is a preregistered multimodal model-comparison program.
primary_test: Nested held-out predictive comparison of functional-circuit, distributed-representational, predictive-interoceptive, and general-arousal/task-demand models, including cue-probability crossed with measured mild respiratory load/sham calibration.
known_limits: The report does not identify a single emotion center or universal biomarker.
The proposed primary study is correlational and cannot make causal claims from ordinary fMRI or physiological association.
The literature synthesis is scoped to selected neuroscience sources and does not replace a systematic review with protocol registration.
